baseline_prompt_en: Create a fictional espionage photograph featuring one reference-guided woman, with weathered clothing carrying visible traces of a return. Use the supplied portrait as guidance for her face and short dark bob with fine separated bangs. On the service-stair landing of a closed archive after rain, she has paused just before a shut steel door. She holds a small sealed cream envelope horizontally at her waist with her left hand; her right thumb presses its sealed flap while her eyes turn down toward the lower flight, caught between verifying the envelope and listening to the stairwell. Her two forearms remain in front of her torso, the hands close enough to share the same focal plane. The lowered shoulders and gently parted lips give her a private, immediate presence. She wears a charcoal cotton mid-thigh coat, whose material tells the visible part of the return: loose pale fibers remain attached to the frayed left cuff edge, a broad diagonal crease has a bright raised ridge and a dark trough across the front panel, the right lapel edge has a paler rubbed patch beside intact darker cloth, and the lower front panel is rain-darkened with distinct water droplets above its hem. The coat remains one continuous garment; intact cloth separates these localized states. Her weight rests on both feet on the level landing, knees relaxed, with a small space between her back and the concrete wall. Frame her from the head to just below the knees, with her face, both hands, coat front and lower hem visible together. A hard amber side light rakes across the coat and meets cool blue light rising from the lower stair. The closed door, descending handrail and rain-bright floor lead the viewer through the place while the face and envelope keep the strongest attention. Natural skin detail, cloth grain and restrained photographic color make this an inhabited moment rather than a costume display.
